analyst_view.overall: Early view: Mainz have one point from five home league games, against nine from four away, and lost four of their last five in all competitions before the break. Union have become harder to beat since a chaotic start under Mauro Lustrinelli but have scored only seven goals in nine, so this has the look of a scrappy, physical game.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals. I lean lower: Mainz have been far more dangerous away than at home, and Union's recent league games have been tight, built on a deep block with little attack. The Union that conceded 17 in its first four games has not been seen since early October.

corners.text: The site expects 9.8 corners, 5.9 for Mainz. Mainz will have to make the game against a Union side that sits deep, which supports their share, while Union's own corners come rarely. I stay close to the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. I lean higher: Fischer wants a 'slightly nasty' style, Mainz had Stefan Posch sent off at Elversberg, and Union's games have been physical, with seven yellows when Köln visited Berlin. Both sides are under pressure in the lower half.

shots.text: The site has 27.2 shots. Union managed no shots in the first half at Freiburg and have no settled striker, so their 10.6 away looks high, and Mainz's home displays have been poor. I lean lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 on target. With Union rarely testing goalkeepers and Mainz's best attacking work coming on the counter away from home rather than in front of their own fans, I lean slightly lower.
